item.description:
Selamat datang di BMZAR! Selamat berbelanja!
Barang spot dikirim dengan cepat dalam waktu 24 jam dan tiba dalam 1-3 hari
Jam kerja layanan pelanggan adalah 8:00-24:00
Kami adalah penjual lokal, penjualan langsung pabrik, otorisasi 100% asli
Harap ingat untuk mengklaim kupon Anda sebelum memesan.
Jika Anda memiliki pertanyaan, harap menghubungi layanan pelanggan tepat waktu dan jangan meninggalkan ulasan buruk.
Ukuran Meja :
- Tinggi Meja 45cm
- Bahan Meja : MDF
- Finishing CAT

Warna: putih/kayu
Ukuran:
Lapisan tunggal
30cm*30cm*40cm
40cm*40cm*50cm
Lapisan ganda
50cm*50cm*50cm
90cm*50cm*42cm
120cm*50cm*42cm

SPESIFIKASI :
Bahan daun meja menggunakan Fiberboard yang kuat dan tebal
Bahan kaki menggunakan kayu Mahoni yang berkualitas
Ketahanan produk kuat hingga 10 tahun
Mampu menahan beban 60kg
Finishing cat duco paint (top coating) Tahan air mudah di bersihkan jika terkena kotoran dan tidak  mudah tergores / mengelupas


 Note :  selama postingan masih ada berarti masih ready
✔Garansi penggantian produk baru jika dalam perjalanan rusak ( sertakan bukti foto lengkap )

Important information:

1. Product is not assembled. Assembly is performed by the customer.
2. When you arrive, please check to make sure the name, color and product code are correct.
3. If it matches the order, please open it.
4. If it does not match the order, please do not disassemble and assemble it. Contact CS today. Don’t forget to document the unboxing process. Request proof of complaint.
5. Make sure the furniture has no defective/damaged parts.
6. If defective/damaged, please contact customer service immediately.
7. Installation manual included in the package.
8. Verified order processing time is ± 2 business days.
9. After the administrative process is completed (2 working days), the goods will be processed and sent expedited. Delivery time ± 7 - 9 working days.
10. Due to the influence of lighting during product photography/rendering and different smartphone screen resolutions, the tolerance for product color similarity is 95%.

  Care Guide:

1. Not recommended to be placed outdoors/in humid places.
2. It is not recommended to move/drag furniture on the floor. Vibration and friction can damage furniture components.
4. If you move the furniture to a higher place (second floor), it is recommended to dismantle the furniture first. Especially suitable for heavy furniture such as cabinets. It is still safe to disassemble and reassemble furniture.
5. Avoid direct contact with water, chemicals and sunlight.
6. Clean the furniture with a dry cloth.
7. If there are stubborn stains, use enough water and wipe the stain immediately with a dry and clean cloth.
